title: From fossil to biobased: a life cycle assessment of commercial-scale polyol ester lubricant base oils
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00641D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Muzan Williams Ijeoma, Zachary Hunt, Hao Chen, Michael Carbajales-Dale
Life cycle assessment (LCA) of biobased ester lubricants shows up to 41% GHG reduction versus fossil-based base oil, highlighting the importance of feedstock optimization and electricity decarbonization for sustainable lubrication.
